page.overview:
Who is Ali-Le?

Ali-Le was a female Voss commando Adjudicator living on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY she was stationed at the commando outpost on Koss Overlook in the Gormak Lands, overlooking Gorma-Koss. She informed a bounty hunter about Republic General Thelonia Redrish, who went into the Gormak territory to negotiate with the Gormak.

Ali-Le appears in Star Wars: The Old Republic during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Captive Audience" on Voss.
